items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: He’s the greatest big band drummer of all time for my money.

ctx.x: Oh Woody, yeah, Woody said that. And that was the only difference between me and the other guys, Dave and Don, he said, “Yeah we can play any tempo with Jake.” He actually

could play any tempo with Don too you know. He could play any tempo, Don Lamond, he’s phenomenal. He’s the greatest big band drummer of all time for my money. And with Dave, he had two tempos. He’d either come down on the one or go up into the other. And once he got there, you never heard anything like that. But otherwise —
This is Dave Tough you’re talking about?
